title: 玛尔扎哈·小虫靠垫
description: 紫色蒙面玛尔扎哈穿完整兜帽长袍，低头给友好的小虚空虫铺靠垫，没有传送攻击或恐怖效果。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Malzahar is an adult Void prophet with a purple hood and wrapped lower face, luminous blue-violet eyes, gold-trimmed robes, and a long floating cloth silhouette. Preserve the covered face and distinctive violet ceremonial outfit with fully opaque sleeves and legs. A small friendly voidling companion has a rounded segmented shell and simple feet, without frightening jaws, swarms, or aggressive magic.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a low cushion and pats a second little cushion into shape for the small voidling waiting beside him. A plain tea bowl and one soft curtain suggest a quiet room. Keep his hands gentle and visible, the creature curious rather than threatening, and any faint magic limited to a soft decorative violet glow.
art_direction.palette: deep purple, pale gold, lavender blue, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
